title: Updating a value inside a segment
statement: Let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers. Suppose $\mu(a+j)=l_j$ for every index $j<|l|$. For any index $i<|l|$ and integer $x$, changing $\mu(a+i)$ to $x$ makes the resulting function agree, starting at $a$, with the list obtained by replacing the entry $l_i$ by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with $l$ at every index in the segment starting at $a$
